input.prompt: Simulate a face centered cubic lattice structure for Aluminum using LAMMPS with a lattice constant of 4.05 angstrom. The simulation should use metal units, define a 5x5x5 simulation box, and set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions. Perform energy minimisation using the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and use conjugate gradient as the minimiser, with force tolerance of 1e-10, energy tolerance of 1e-10, maximum iterations of 1e+5 and maximum evaluations of 1e+5. Then, run NPT simulations with timestep of 1 femtosecond using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose-Hoover pressure barostat at 0 pressure units and 300 temperature units with pressure damping factor of 1.0 and temperature damping factor of 0.1. As the final output, give the density of the system in g/cm^3 units. The input script used for this simulation should be named input.in

Simulate a face centered cubic lattice structure for Aluminum using LAMMPS with a lattice constant of 4.05 angstrom and do not perform energy minimisation. The simulation should use metal units, define a 5x5x5 simulation box and set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions. Save this structure using write_data command in LAMMPS in structure.xyz file. As the final output, give the absolute path of the structure file. The input script used for this simulation should be named subtask_1.in

You are given the absolute path of the structure file of Aluminum face centered cubic lattice. Read that structure file and perform energy minimisation using the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and use conjugate gradient as the minimiser, with force tolerance of 1e-10, energy tolerance of 1e-10, maximum iterations of 1e+5 and maximum evaluations of 1e+5. After energy minimisation, save the minimised structure using write_data command in LAMMPS in minimised_structure.dat file, and as the final output, give the absolute path of the minimised structure file. The input script used for this simulation should be named subtask_2.in

You are given the absolute path of the minimised structure of Aluminum face centered cubic lattice. Read that structure file and run NPT simulations with timestep of 1 femtosecond using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose-Hoover pressure barostat at 0 pressure units and 300 temperature units with pressure damping factor of 1.0 and temperature damping factor of 0.1. As the final output, give the density of the system in g/cm^3 units. The input script used for this simulation should be named subtask_3.in
